items.question: Does any live Agent Pay authorization check a Verifiable Intent chain today?
items.context: Mastercard says it is embedding VI into the payment flow and that AP4M agents can be recognized with it, but no public record shows a VI chain checked in production.

items.question: Where is the Mastercard key directory, and how are keys rotated and delisted?
items.context: The only host in the docs does not resolve; rotation and delisting are undocumented.

items.question: Who carries the loss when an agent buys the wrong thing within its limits?
items.context: No agent-specific reason codes or liability shift are published; an unattributed answer in VI issue 15 says liability work is ongoing.

items.question: Can a Verifiable Intent Autonomous mandate satisfy PSD2 SCA when the user is absent?
items.context: VI says it gives a cryptographic form of dynamic linking but does not replace SCA; no regulator has addressed it.

items.question: Will Verifiable Intent fix the duplicate-digest conflict with RFC 9901?
items.context: Issue 29 has been open since 2026-07-17 with no maintainer response, and the repository has had no commits since 2026-04-20.

items.question: How reliably do authorization messages mark agent involvement?
items.context: The 2026-09-30 probability score test implies agent involvement is not always marked; its fields and thresholds are unpublished.

items.question: How will Mastercard's tag and directory align with the IETF Web Bot Auth draft?
items.context: Mastercard uses its own tag, while the working group draft requires web-bot-auth; no alignment plan is published.

items.question: What does Agent Pay for Machines settle on, and at what cost?
items.context: Mastercard describes multi-rail settlement across cards, accounts and stablecoins but publishes no flow, pricing or chain addresses.
